notes.title: v1.5.16 (X-Ray Swinky Front + Bug fixes)
notes.notes:
- X-Ray Swinky Front.
- Help is now called at the very beginning of the story.
- Swinky ass is shaking when spanked.

Fixed:
- Bugs with game crashes when changing the language. And some other problems with languages.
- Awful bug with the impossibility of activating a dialogue in Free Mode.
